messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt to PROD started for tag v2.14.0 (commit abc123). CI gate failed — 3 failing checks: dependency-scan, e2e:chrome, lint. Deploy is on hold. Pipeline: https://ci.redwood.example/pipeline/12345

jessica: On it — reassigning @samir for the e2e flake and looping in @marco for release decisions.

samir: grabbing logs now. e2e fail looks like a timeout in login flow: `TimeoutError: waiting for selector \"#login-btn\"` on chrome. Looks like a flake or test data issue, not code crash.

marco: Dependency scan failing shows a signature mismatch for transitive package `fastxml` 1.2.5 (newly introduced). That might be a blocker for prod until sec gives thumbs up. Options: pin lockfile to previous working version or rollback. Thoughts?

kira: I can repro the e2e locally if someone seeds the test account. @samir, want me to run `pytest tests/e2e/test_login.py::test_login_timeout -k chrome`?

samir: yes please. Also I'll try a rerun of only the failed jobs. `./tools/retry-ci --pipeline 12345 --only failed`

vila: Change window is open until 21:00 UTC, so we can do a hotfix patch in-window. Prefer to avoid emergency changes if sec flags the package.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: user jessica requested a rerun (jobs: e2e:chrome, lint). Rerun queued (build 12345.2).

jessica: If rerun clears e2e and lint but dependency-scan still complains, we should pin the dependency in the lockfile and create a patch release (v2.14.1-pin). That buys time for sec to investigate the signature.

samir: local reproduce: same timeout until I increase chrome headless timeout. With extended timeout the test passes. Might be flaky CI environment. e2e likely not the root cause.

deploy-bot: Rerun finished: e2e:chrome PASSED on retry, lint PASSED. dependency-scan FAILED — signature mismatch on `fastxml@1.2.5`.

marco: OK, dependency-scan failure is blocking. @sec-bot can you kick off a package verification and eng-security review? We should not promote 1.2.5 until it's cleared.

sec-bot: Security review requested for package `fastxml@1.2.5` (issue #SEC-482). Automated verification returned \"signature_mismatch\". Paging @sec-team. Estimated TTR 2-4 hours.

kira: For release notes: add an item under \"Known issues\" — deploy held due to dependency signature mismatch, patch will pin to 1.2.4 until sec clears 1.2.5.

jessica: I'll open the lockfile pin PR now (branch: hotfix/pin-fastxml-1.2.4). If CI passes on that build we can unhold and cut v2.14.1.

vila: Please include rollback instructions in the PR description and a change-window tag. Ops will standby for rollout once sec approves or pin build passes.

marco: I'll draft the rollback playbook: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=<previous>` and add monitoring checks for 5m post-deploy.

deploy-bot: New build queued for hotfix branch (pipeline 12346). Current thread will remain on hold until dependency-scan passes or security approves.

samir: thanks — I'll monitor pipeline 12346 and follow up if e2e reappears.

jessica: :thumbsup: updating release notes draft and linking SEC-482 and PR #4321 in the changelog.

sec-bot: Security triage acked. Assigned to @sec-oncall. Next update ETA ~90 minutes.

marco: If sec can't clear the package quickly, we proceed with pin PR and a patch release in-window. No rollback expected if pin succeeds.

deploy-bot: Last status update (1987654380): pipeline 12346 in progress. Thread remains blocked by dependency-scan until SEC-482 resolved or hotfix passes.
